name: wv-connectors
description: Zero-footprint West Virginia Gemini Enterprise (GE) & BigQuery connector playbooks for Entra-synced @wv.gov accounts across Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Gmail, Drive, GitHub, and cost-capped BigQuery (zero local MCP subprocesses or open ports).
suggestedPrompts: Run /connect-ge to configure my West Virginia Gemini Enterprise instance and verify federated connector readiness
Run /connect-m365-workspace to synthesize Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, or Drive records with strict citations
Run /connect-github-bigquery to set up cost-capped 1 GB read-only BigQuery analytics for WV dashboards
